sequenced-map-api-concept.title: SequencedMap operations
sequenced-map-api-concept.summary: SequencedMap adds first, last, and reversed-view operations to maps with encounter order.
sequenced-map-api-concept.why: The interface exposes order-sensitive map operations directly instead of requiring implementation-specific handling.
sequenced-map-api-concept.tips: Use an implementation such as LinkedHashMap when encounter order matters.

memory-segment-lifecycle-concept.title: MemorySegment lifetime
memory-segment-lifecycle-concept.short: Tie off-heap memory to an Arena
memory-segment-lifecycle-concept.summary: The Foreign Function and Memory API models memory through MemorySegment values whose lifetime is controlled by an Arena.
memory-segment-lifecycle-concept.why: Explicit lifetime management makes native-memory ownership visible and prevents access after the arena is closed.
memory-segment-lifecycle-concept.tips: Prefer a confined Arena in simple single-threaded scopes and close it with try-with-resources.

math-clamp-range.title: Clamp a number to a range
math-clamp-range.summary: Math.clamp returns a value constrained to the supplied minimum and maximum.
math-clamp-range.why: It expresses range limiting directly without nested min/max calls.
math-clamp-range.tips: Ensure the lower bound is not greater than the upper bound.

files-read-attributes-map.title: Read selected file attributes
files-read-attributes-map.short: Fetch several attributes in one Files call
files-read-attributes-map.summary: Files.readAttributes can retrieve a selected group of file-system attributes as a map.
files-read-attributes-map.why: It avoids separate metadata calls when several attributes are needed together.
files-read-attributes-map.tips: Use a typed BasicFileAttributes read when compile-time attribute types are more useful.

already-bound-channel-exception.title: Channel already bound
already-bound-channel-exception.short: Do not bind the same network channel twice
already-bound-channel-exception.summary: AlreadyBoundException indicates that a network channel already has a local binding.
already-bound-channel-exception.why: A second bind operation cannot replace an existing channel binding.
already-bound-channel-exception.tips: Bind once during channel setup and keep binding state out of repeated request logic.

not-yet-connected-channel-exception.title: Channel not connected yet
not-yet-connected-channel-exception.short: Connect a socket channel before I/O
not-yet-connected-channel-exception.summary: NotYetConnectedException is thrown when an operation requires a connected channel but connection has not completed.
not-yet-connected-channel-exception.why: Socket read and write operations need an established peer.
not-yet-connected-channel-exception.tips: Use SocketChannel.open(address) for a simple blocking connect or finishConnect for non-blocking connection setup.

enum-constructor-access-error.title: Enum constructor access
enum-constructor-access-error.short: Enum constructors cannot be public or protected
enum-constructor-access-error.summary: Declare enum constructors without public or protected access.
enum-constructor-access-error.why: Enum instances are created only by the enum constants declared by the type.
enum-constructor-access-error.tips: Package-private-looking enum constructors are effectively private to enum instance creation.

unnamed-variable-reference-error.title: Referencing an unnamed variable
unnamed-variable-reference-error.short: An underscore declaration cannot be read later
unnamed-variable-reference-error.summary: Java 22 unnamed variables and patterns use _ specifically when a value is intentionally not used.
unnamed-variable-reference-error.why: The underscore does not introduce a variable name that later expressions can reference.
unnamed-variable-reference-error.tips: Give the variable a real name when its value is needed in the body.

removal-lint-warning.title: Removal warning
removal-lint-warning.summary: Using an API deprecated for removal can produce a removal warning.
removal-lint-warning.why: forRemoval=true signals that a future Java release may remove the API rather than merely discourage it.
removal-lint-warning.tips: Migrate to the documented replacement before upgrading makes the removal unavoidable.

stringbuilder-equals-identity-trap.title: StringBuilder equality trap
stringbuilder-equals-identity-trap.short: StringBuilder.equals does not compare text contents
stringbuilder-equals-identity-trap.summary: StringBuilder inherits identity-based equals behavior, so two builders with the same characters are not equal objects.
stringbuilder-equals-identity-trap.why: Unlike String, StringBuilder does not override Object.equals to compare character sequences.
stringbuilder-equals-identity-trap.tips: Convert to String or otherwise compare character contents when textual equality is required.
